messages:
eva: Quick copy check for the Drafts empty state on the Editor page. Current: "No drafts yet" with a primary CTA "New". Feels unclear. Figma: https://figma.redwood/editor-drafts-empty
rick: Agreed. Suggest helper line + clearer CTA. Helper: "Create a draft to save changes while you iterate." Button: "Create draft". Mobile CTA: "New draft".
kim: Accessibility note: helper text should be programmatically linked to the CTA via aria-describedby. Also ensure the CTA is first in tab order when empty.
a11y-bot: Checklist: role=status for helper? Prefer not; use visible text + aria-describedby. Ensure contrast and focus-visible styles. (auto-note)
eva: Final proposal locked: Helper: "Create a draft to save changes while you iterate." Button: "Create draft" Mobile: "New draft" Implementation notes in ticket #4750: CTA first focus, aria-describedby, localization length < 40 chars. rick will PR.
rick: I'll submit PR and ping for design + a11y review. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
